tested:
Some real IOL binaries in the wild are named without the "i86bi"/"iou" token at all -
bare "L2-ADVENTERPRISEK9-M" / "L3-ADVENTERPRISEK9-M" (Cisco internal test-build names).
Without these, get_profile() found no match for them at all and they silently fell
through to GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (a QEMU-shaped profile - wrong emulator, wrong interface
naming) instead of the correct IOL router/switch profile. Found 2026-07-21 alongside the
matching frontend Library-badge gap (computeImageRoleKey in StudioHome.tsx).

reasons.min_ram_mb:
default_ram_mb 512 -> 1024 (NPX-1527 PROFILES-TOOLS pass-3, rule #59): EVE-NG's
real iol.yml sets ram: 1024 with no separate default/floor split - the old 512
here had no written reason, matching EVE exactly now.
reasons.nic: NPX-1527 review (Wave 38): IolProvider.get_console returns ConsoleType.SERIAL (raw PTY bridge), so the profile must say "serial" - not EVE's "telnet" label; verified in iol_provider.py get_console. No consumer treats the two differently today.

settings.description: Cisco IOL L2 switch (bare-named build) - requires 32-bit userspace libc.
